text.tspan: Two families, explicit roles and a small scale keep the brand recognisable without complicating the interface.
Lead Developer / Product Manager - Marcin Kordyaczny
URLs, email, code, metadata and FIONN AI
Use Regular 400 for body, navigation and marketing
copy; SemiBold 600 for headings and emphasis.
Product body copy starts at 16 px with 24 px line
height. Keep letter spacing at zero. Navigation labels
stay in this family even when they are links. Use only
shipped weights, without synthetic bold. The
browser may slant prose emphasis because Space
Grotesk has no dedicated italic face.
Use Regular 400 for URLs, email, code, versions, API
endpoints and technical metadata. Use SemiBold
case-sensitive paths. Small technical labels may use
A 48 px heading belongs on an editorial cover; use
24-32 px page titles and 18-20 px section headings
in tools. Supporting text should remain at least 14
px. Constrain line lengths and allow wrapping before
